title: Stock
noAccess: You do not have permission to see this page.

problems.decimals: More decimals than this unit allows.
problems.whole: This unit takes whole numbers only.

picker.search: Search stock items by name, code or barcode

opening.title: Opening stock
opening.subtitle: Stock quantities and their cost when the system starts.
opening.explain: Opening stock is entered once, at go-live, and only the owner posts it. An empty unit cost takes the item's purchase price. The journal entry is Inventory (debit) / Opening balance equity (credit).
opening.ownerOnly: Only the owner posts opening stock. You can view the posted documents.
opening.importIntro: Download the template and fill in, per item: Code, Quantity and Unit cost (excl. VAT, optional). The file is checked first; then all rows are posted together, or none.

form.title: New opening stock
form.empty: Search for an item, add it, then type its quantity.
form.costUnknown: This item has no cost: type the unit cost.
form.partial: The value shows once every quantity and cost is known.
form.noReason: The "Opening stock" reason is missing from the lists. Contact the system administrator.
form.fix: Correct the marked lines and try again.

counts.title: Stock counts
counts.subtitle: Count the stock on the shelves and compare it with the system.

list.label: Stock counts
list.empty: No counts yet. Start a new count.

new.title: Start a new count
new.explain: System quantities are frozen when the count starts, and the people counting do not see them. Only one count can be open at a time.
new.duplicate: A count is already open. Finish or cancel it before starting a new one.

count.title: Count
count.blind: Type what you really count on the shelf. The system quantity is not shown while counting.
count.fix: Correct the marked quantities, then save.

review.title: Review the differences
review.explain: Difference = counted − (system quantity at the start + movements since). Every difference needs a reason.
review.reasonMissing: Choose a reason for this difference.
review.incomplete_one: {count} item is not counted yet. Count it before posting.
review.incomplete_other: {count} items are not counted yet. Count them before posting.
review.needReasons: Choose a reason for every difference before posting.
review.approval: The differences are above the allowed limit: a supervisor's approval is needed.
review.approvalExplain: The value of this count's differences is above the allowed limit. A supervisor approves with their PIN on this PC.
review.cancelExplain: The count is cancelled and no stock changes. It stays on record as "Cancelled".

reviews.title: Oversell reviews
reviews.subtitle: Sales beyond the stock on hand, approved by a supervisor, waiting for the storekeeper.
reviews.explain: When a sale needs more than the stock on hand, a supervisor approves it at the POS and a stock adjustment is posted automatically. Check the shelf, then record what you found. If the real stock differs, correct it with a count or an adjustment.
reviews.emptyPendingHint: Every sale beyond the stock on hand, approved by a supervisor at the POS, appears here.

dialog.title: Mark reviewed
dialog.explain: Write what you found on the shelf. The note is kept on the document and in the audit log.
dialog.noteHint: e.g. found the quantity in the back store
dialog.noteTooShort: Write a note of at least 3 characters.
